text.content:
Desert, nomads and raiders, all around the city.

Region: Outside Night City
Controlled by: Nobody, and the nomad clans
Feel: Climate-wrecked desert and long empty roads
Danger: Raiders like the Wraiths

Decades of climate change and stripped resources have turned the land outside Night City into desert. Nomads cross it, raiders hunt it, and some fixers, like Dakota Smith, work from garages out here.

Gig hooks

  • A stranded nomad family needs parts from the city, and someone needs them stranded.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.32
